user_query: We are planning a Phase 3 randomised controlled trial of a next-generation proteasome inhibitor in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, targeting patients with 2–3 prior lines of therapy including lenalidomide and a prior PI. The trial will be conducted globally across the US, EU, and Asia-Pacific. We are seeking FDA and EMA label claims and will need NICE and ICER submissions. The mechanism involves weekly IV administration with step-up dosing in Cycle 1. Our TPP focuses on improvement in bone pain and physical functioning, but we also need to capture fatigue and treatment tolerability. Please generate a full COA strategy.
answer:
## COA Measurement Strategy — Multiple Myeloma Phase 3

**In one sentence:** This trial needs to demonstrate patient-perceived benefit in bone pain and physical functioning while capturing the step-up dosing tolerability profile that differentiates next-generation PIs from existing agents.

**Key challenge:** Balancing comprehensive domain coverage against patient burden in a heavily pre-treated RRMM population with high dropout risk.

**Recommended starting point:** EORTC QLQ-C30 + QLQ-MY20 (disease-specific pain/symptoms) + EQ-5D-5L (HTA requirement) based on KG evidence of change detection in 4/5 comparator trials [TI-001, TI-002, TI-003, TI-005].

**Critical gap:** No KG scoring data available for Domain Coverage Matrix — expert will need instrument-to-domain mapping for FDA core concepts.

## Table 1: Domain Coverage Comparison

| FDA Core Concept | Source | Current Trial Candidates | A.R.R.O.W. [TI-001] | ALCYONE [TI-002] | APEX [TI-004] |
|-----------------|--------|------------------------|-------------------|-----------------|---------------|
| Disease-related bone pain | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | No KG scoring data available | EORTC QLQ-MY20 ✅ Change: Y [TI-001] | ❌ Not collected¹ | ❌ Not collected¹ |
| Physical function | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | No KG scoring data available | EORTC QLQ-C30 ⚠️ General (partial significance) | EORTC QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: Y [TI-002] | EORTC QLQ-C30 ⚠️ General (partial significance) |
| Fatigue | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | No KG scoring data available | ❌ Not collected² | ❌ Not collected² | ❌ Not collected² |
| Symptomatic adverse events | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | No KG scoring data available | CSQ-8 ✅ Change: Y [TI-001] | ❌ Not collected | FACT/GOG-NTX ⚠️ Change: NR [TI-004] |
| HTA utility | HTA requirement (NICE/ICER) | No KG scoring data available | EQ-5D-5L ✅ Change: Y [TI-001] | EQ-5D-5L ✅ Change: Y [TI-002] | ❌ Not collected |

¹MM-specific pain not measured — trials focused on general oncology domains
²Fatigue not measured as standalone domain — captured within QLQ-C30 general scales only

## Table 2: PRO Measures Comparison

| Trial | Year | Drug | Drug class | PRO Measures (n items) | Calibrated SOA | Total items | Est. time |
|-------|------|------|------------|----------------------|---------------|-------------|-----------|
| A.R.R.O.W. [TI-001] | Not reported | carfilzomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30 (30), QLQ-MY20 (20), EQ-5D-5L (6), CSQ-8 (8) | No | 64 | 22-28 min |
| ALCYONE [TI-002] | Not reported | daratumumab | CD38 monoclonal antibody | EORTC QLQ-C30 (30), EQ-5D-5L (6) | No | 36 | 15-18 min |
| APEX [TI-004] | Not reported | bortezomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30 (30), FACT/GOG-NTX (n=?) | No | 30+ | 15+ min |
| Current Trial (Proposed) | 2024 | Next-gen PI | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30 (30), QLQ-MY20 (20), EQ-5D-5L (6), BFI (9) | TBD — expert decision required | 65 | 24-31 min |

## Key Observations

• **Same-class precedent exists:** A.R.R.O.W. [TI-001] used carfilzomib (proteasome inhibitor) with EORTC QLQ-C30 + MY20 + EQ-5D-5L and achieved significant change in MY20 pain scales (p<0.01), providing direct evidence these instruments are sensitive in PI trials [TI-001]. This combination detected meaningful differences in bone pain and functioning domains directly relevant to current TPP claims.

• **PRO positioning pattern:** In 53 KG trial-instrument records for MM, 98% used PRO as secondary endpoints with 0% primary — suggesting secondary positioning aligns with regulatory precedent while preserving statistical power for survival endpoints. This distribution indicates regulatory agencies accept PRO as confirmatory secondary endpoints in MM trials.

• **Missing domain coverage identified:** Fatigue appears in only 1/5 comparator trials despite being a core FDA domain and TPP claim [IR-001]. BFI (9 items, 2-3 min) has established MCID of 1.33 points and FDA acceptance for secondary endpoints [IR-001], filling this critical gap.

• **HTA utility requirement:** NICE mandates EQ-5D for QALY calculation, and 3/5 comparator trials successfully used EQ-5D-5L [TI-001, TI-002, TI-005]. EQ-5D-5L detected significant changes in 2/3 trials, with MCID of 0.04-0.08 index points [IR-006].

• **Rejection pattern analysis:** Common FDA/EMA rejection reasons include "no testing hierarchy" [REJ-031], "no multiplicity adjustment" [REJ-032], and "excessive missing data" [REJ-039]. These patterns emphasize the need for pre-specified hierarchical testing and robust missing data management in the statistical analysis plan.

• **MM-specific context needed:** EORTC QLQ-MY20 provides disease-specific bone pain and symptoms beyond general QLQ-C30, with evidence of change detection in proteasome inhibitor trials [TI-001]. Generic QLQ-C30 alone showed only "partial" significance in APEX bortezomib trial [TI-004], suggesting MM module adds sensitivity.

## Comparator Analysis

| Drug | Mechanism | PRO Instruments Used | Outcome | Implication for Current Trial |
|------|-----------|---------------------|---------|------------------------------|
| carfilzomib [TI-001] | Proteasome Inhibitor | QLQ-C30, MY20, EQ-5D-5L, CSQ-8 | MY20 significant (p<0.01), EQ-5D significant (p<0.01) | Direct same-class evidence that QLQ-MY20 detects PI benefit in bone pain |
| daratumumab [TI-002] | CD38 antibody | QLQ-C30, EQ-5D-5L | Both significant (p<0.05) | Different mechanism achieved HRQoL benefit with simpler battery |
| bortezomib [TI-004] | Proteasome Inhibitor | QLQ-C30, FACT/GOG-NTX | QLQ-C30 partial, NTX not reported | First-generation PI had limited HRQoL signal — next-gen may perform better |

Based on comparator evidence, EORTC QLQ-MY20 has the strongest signal of change in PI trials because it captured significant benefit (p<0.01) in the carfilzomib A.R.R.O.W. trial [TI-001] where generic QLQ-C30 showed only partial significance.

## HTA Requirements

| HTA Body | Required Instrument | In candidate list? | Action needed |
|----------|-------------------|-------------------|---------------|
| NICE/ICER | EQ-5D-5L | Yes | Include in battery — mandatory for QALY calculation |

## What the Expert Needs to Decide

1. Whether to include BFI as standalone fatigue measure or rely on QLQ-C30 fatigue subscale for this domain.

2. Position of PRO endpoints in hierarchical testing sequence — secondary positioning follows 98% of KG precedent but requires upstream survival endpoint success.

3. Assessment schedule alignment with step-up dosing to capture early tolerability signal in Cycle 1.

4. Whether CSQ-8 from A.R.R.O.W. precedent [TI-001] adds value for capturing treatment satisfaction specific to PI administration experience.

5. Missing data mitigation strategy given high dropout risk in RRMM population and regulatory sensitivity to excessive missingness [REJ-039].
